_comment: Mixamo character registry. Keyed by our slug. character_id is Adobe's permanent UUID — survives across sessions, so once registered, fetching new animations never requires re-uploading the FBX. skeletonClass groups characters by rig + proportion family; add-anim-everywhere.ts filters by it. animatorId is the key in apps/web/src/lib/three/character-anim-overrides.json AND in agent-model-registry.ts (defaults to slug). animationsDir is the URL path prefix (defaults to /avatars/animations/<slug>). Canonical skeleton classes: (1) mixamo-adult-male — Tekk, Hermes-male: per-character bakes (different proportions, wings vs lean) so they get separate slugs + dirs but live in the same class for batch operations. (2) mixamo-adult-female — Hermes-female: per-character bake. (3) vrm-milady — all 8 Milady VRMs share ONE Mixamo upload + ONE animationsDir /avatars/animations/vrm-milady/ because mesh + proportions are identical across the fork; every Milady VRM uses animatorId='vrm-milady'. (4) crustacean — lobster + future GLB crustaceans: no Mixamo path (rigs incompatible with Mixamo's humanoid auto-rig); animations hand-crafted in Blender. add-anim-everywhere.ts skips this class. See README.md for the workflow.
